answer: Proposed: each paid garden agent scheduling cedar irrigation registers its key before a daily random beacon, then submits a delay proof of 10^8 serial steps seeded by both. Validators check proof, key/day binding and day-end deadline; missing, late or invalid proofs deny daily pay. Assuming no cross-key shortcuts, shared hosts cannot reuse work. Hardware is reusable capital; power or compute rent recurs; no stake is locked. Faster chips and outsourcing can lower costs; owners need not be unique. Parallel runs shorten elapsed time, not the 10^9 aggregate steps needed for ten keys.
